2607.21267.title: BasketEvent: Understanding Who Did What and When in Basketball Videos
2607.21267.paper_summary: Comprehensive basketball video understanding requires resolving not only what event occurs, but also who is responsible and when the key evidence appears. However, exist- ing methods typically treat spatial perception and semantic recognition as isolated tasks, failing to ground events to individual players or pinpoint their temporal boundaries within complex collective dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce BasketEvent, a player- centric basketball event understanding dataset curated from real NBA broadcasts. In BasketEvent, event labels are grounded to the responsible players, and a manually an- notated subset of 1,000 samples with precise event intervals is provided to evaluate tem- poral evidence localization. Based on this data, we propose PlayNet, a player-centric reasoning framework that maps basketball videos to player-level event predictions with temporal evidence. Concretely, PlayNet tracks key entities, associates player identities, and reasons about events by modeling player-player, player-ball, and global court inter- actions, while aggregating sparse temporal evidence via gated pooling. Extensive experi- ments demonstrate that PlayNet significantly outperforms representative video-level and crop-based baselines, proving the superiority of player-centric modeling for fine-grained sports video understanding. Our data, code, and models will be made publicly available.
2607.21267.paper_summary_zh: 全面的籃球視頻理解不僅需要解決發生了什麼事件，還需要了解誰負責以及關鍵證據何時出現。<lb/>然而，現有的方法通常將空間感知和語義識別視為孤立的任務，未能將事件與個別球員聯繫起來或確定其在複雜集體動態中的時間邊界。<lb/>為了填補這一空白，我們引入了BasketEvent，一個以球員為中心的籃球事件理解數據集，該數據集來自真實的NBA廣播。<lb/>在BasketEvent中，事件標籤與負責的球員相對應，並提供了一個手動標註的1,000個樣本的子集，具有精確的事件間隔，以評估時間證據的定位。<lb/>基於這些數據，我們提出了PlayNet，一個以球員為中心的推理框架，將籃球視頻映射到球員級別的事件預測和時間證據。<lb/>具體而言，PlayNet跟踪關鍵實體，關聯球員身份，並通過建模球員之間、球員與球以及全場的互動來推理事件，同時通過門控池化聚合稀疏的時間證據。<lb/>大量實驗表明，PlayNet顯著超越了代表性視頻級別和裁剪基準，證明了以球員為中心的建模在細粒度體育視頻理解中的優越性。<lb/>我們的數據、代碼和模型將公開提供。
